summary: Resolved all three P2 findings: bulk missing estimates select canonical work leaves; aggregate planning tooltips disclose excluded uncalibrated leaves independently of kind spelling; a command-level default-mode tier regression proves one warning per unclassified native work case and exit 0. Classified four existing work CLI registrations discovered by strict affected-package reconciliation. No assertions relaxed.

ownership.attribution: Coordinator recorded worker marker before dispatch, per worker-common.md. No tracker status change.

findings.changes: On a workspace registering work, request kind=work, shape=leaf within the resolved project; accept only explicitly identified canonical leaves. Legacy-only kind registries keep their existing selection. Pagination bounds, preflight of the entire plan, already-estimated skips, revision preconditions and honest partial-write errors are retained.
findings.regression: TestEstimateMissingMigratedWorkLeaves: dry-run, apply, stale revision, parent target, unknown shape, missing revision. Two-page bounded project read; no writes in dry-run or invalid plans; existing person estimate preserved; agent provenance not forged. Fixture is synchronized with a mutex and mutates the person estimate after encoding the read snapshot, without sleeps.

findings.finding: Parent planning estimates hide incomplete coverage
findings.changes: Use planning.children aggregate metadata for the sum basis in both token and cost tooltips. Emit the basis once for complete and partial aggregates, with singular/plural uncalibrated-leaf exclusions.
findings.regression: Canonical work row, explicit parent and shape-absent responses, no usage and measured usage, 0/1/2 excluded leaves; independent token and cost subtests. Existing figures remain covered by their original assertions.

regression.method: Collect native registrations without running their bodies. Child-process import hook isolates collection breadth and supplies a fixture manifest containing only a known sibling. The unchanged command, main and validator execute; assertions require exact warning identities/count and NIGHTLY inventory count. Strict classification checks remain separate.

added.name: canonical work aggregates disclose excluded uncalibrated leaves in token and cost tips

classification.new_policy: New estimate target/revision guard, existing completion-write refusal and cancellation/input bounds are ESSENTIAL; ordinary alias and aggregate regressions are NIGHTLY. Existing rows/tiers are preserved.

go_targeted.toolchain: Go 1.26.6; existing store executable, no local Nix evaluation

ci_harness_file.note: Existing full planning and browser-selector tests enumerate native registrations; no browser process is launched. The default-mode regression invokes a separate CLI process.

baseline.go: Final migrated-leaf regression fails against exact original estimates.go via Go -overlay: legacy ticket,task scope and canonical nodes rejected. All six scenario subtests fail for the original scope/kind behavior.
baseline.web: Final unchanged assertions fail independently for token and cost against exact original planning.ts supplied through a Node load hook: aggregate sum and exclusion warnings are absent.
baseline.command_coverage: Default warning behavior already existed; the new regression passes against the unchanged tier command. This is a missing-coverage fix, not a product behavior change.
baseline.method: git show baseline source into ignored worktree files; overlay/load hook substitutes only production dependencies. No tracked source or assertions replaced.

validation.remote_go: Not invoked: remote-test.sh transfers HEAD with git push to a temporary remote test ref; the direct user no-push instruction was preserved. Only the affected quick package selections ran locally. No full Go or DB migration suite is claimed.

validation.full_suites: No fresh full Go/DB suite, npm build, full web unit suite, Linux Chromium execution or hosted CI rerun is claimed. Coordinator must run those after an authorized push. The newly classified existing DB-backed completion regression was enumerated but not executed this round.

design_decisions: No conflict with approved design fragments or ticket decisions was found. This round changes aggregate tooltip explanations using the existing planning cells; it adds no UI layout or control.
constraints: Assigned worktree and branch only; no push, deploy, release gate, production mutation, secrets, credentials, version or migration change, foreign-worktree edits, subagents or other model CLIs/reviews.
